data.title: Precision determination of the ground-state hyperfine splitting in 137Ba+ using the ion-storage technique
data.notes: RF quadrupole ion trap measurement of the ground-state hyperfine splitting of 137Ba+. About 10^5 ions stored, hyperfine pumping by pulsed tunable dye laser, microwave transitions between Zeeman sublevels induced and detected via fluorescence. Result: Whfs = 8037741667.69(0.36) Hz (precision 4.6e-11). This corresponds to A(6s 2S1/2) = Whfs/2 = 4018870833.85(0.18) Hz = 4018.87083385(18) MHz. Uncertainty split equally from extrapolation to zero electric field and zero magnetic field.

properties.notes: A = Whfs/2 = 8037741667.69(0.36) Hz / 2. For I=3/2, J=1/2: delta_E(F=2->F=1) = 2A. The same value is reproduced in Hucul et al. 2017 (doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.119.100501) Table 1.
